worker: /validate.js` has one new check after the total check. It pushes `'currency: must be three uppercase letters'` when `currency` is not `undefined` and is not a three-letter uppercase string. A missing currency stays valid, `null` counts as invalid, and the function applies no default.
- **Tests:** the two original tests in `src/validate.test.js` are untouched. I added one for an order without currency and one for `'USD'`. A loop covers `'usd'`, `'US'`, `'USDD'`, `123` and `''`, each expecting exactly the one error.

The commit touches only those three files.

Git warned that LF in `src/validate.test.js` will be converted to CRLF the next time it touches the file. I didn't change line endings.
